instruction:
Rework templates/chota-react-redux/src/containers/TodoListContainer.jsx for the CEO, who reviewed it and rejected it with this feedback:

"The container's selector (getVisibleTodos) builds a new object on every call, so the todo list re-renders on every store update even when it did not change: three theme toggles cause three re-renders (measured with React 19.2.5 and React-Redux 9.2.0). shallowEqual only hides it on the All filter. Make the selector memoized (createSelector) so it returns the same reference when its inputs are unchanged, and keep the template consistent with the other templates and the state-selectors skill."

Rewrite that file so it answers the feedback point by point. Keep its front matter fields (update a claim or source only when the feedback asks), keep the channel's format and limits, and do not change any other file.
